outputs.summary_en: The image announces a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' stating that the government is providing free laptops to all students. It mentions an application deadline of October 15 and asks users to register their names by clicking on a provided link, www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in. The post also urges users to forward it to all groups.

claims.claim_original: प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना 2026 सभी छात्रों को सरकार की ओर से मुफ्त लैपटॉप दिया जा रहा है।
claims.claim_en: The Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'.
search_queries_en: Indian government free laptop scheme students

outputs.visual_description_en: The image is a digital graphic with an orange header and white background. The header contains the text '□□ बड़ी खुशखबरी □□' (Big Good News). The main body of the text, in black, announces 'प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना 2026' (Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026) and states that free laptops are being given to all students by the government. It specifies an application deadline of '15 अक्टूबर' (October 15) and instructs users to click a link to register their name. A blue URL, 'www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in', is prominently displayed. The final line, in red, says 'इसे सभी ग्रुप में फॉरवर्ड करें' (Forward this to all groups).
